text: (1) A copy of the personal information page of your valid passport. Applicants currently residing in mainland China must also provide a scanned copy of the currently valid visa page or residence permit page. The passport should be valid until at least October 30, 2025. (2) A copy of the high school diploma (or graduation certificate) and all transcripts. It should be the original documents or be notarized. (3) Personal statement (based on the given template) and CV. (4) Chinese or English language certificate. In the following circumstances, a language certificate is not required: - Applicants who are native Chinese speakers and are applying for Chinese-medium courses. - Applicants who are native English speakers and are applying for English-medium courses. (5) Non-criminal record (valid for six months). (6) Officially certified awards and scientific research achievements (if any). (7) Copy of the "Physical Examination Form for Foreigners" (valid for six months); (8) As of November 1st, 2025, minor applicants under the age of 18 must provide a Guardian Guarantee Letter (based on the given template). (9) Personal or parents' bank statements for the last six months (5000USD). (10) Other supplementary materials required. Note: 1) For the list of English-speaking countries, please refer to the official website of NPU International College: 英语为母语的国家信息 English as Native Language List.pdf 2) All the above application materials must be in English or Chinese. Notarized English or Chinese translations are required if the materials are in other languages.
